mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `idevelop_device_inventory` ( `id`, `region_code`, `crop_id`, `device_category`, `device_category_name`, `device_type`, `device_type_name`, `warehouse`, `warehouse_name`, `inventory_num`, `version`, `create_user`, `create_time`, `is_deleted`) VALUES( #{id}, #{regionCode}, #{cropId}, #{deviceCategory}, #{deviceCategoryName}, #{deviceType}, #{deviceTypeName}, #{warehouse}, #{warehouseName}, #{inventoryNum}, 0, #{createUser}, #{createTime}, #{isDeleted}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE inventory_num = inventory_num + #{inventoryNum},version = version + 1
mapper.select: select sum(inventory_num) as inventory_num FROM idevelop_device_inventory where warehouse = #{warehouse} and device_category = #{deviceCategory}
